shot_function: state the specific dramatic or informational function of this shot
narrative_responsibility: describe what the audience must perceive by the end of the shot
required_visible_changes: name the visible story-state change needed for this particular shot
architecture_choice: describe the chosen combination of integrated scene, paper actors, props, effects, masks, or deliberate stillness
merged_elements: name elements kept together and explain the contact, perspective, identity, light, or stillness reason
independent_elements: name only elements whose independent change benefits the shot
camera_and_presentation_role: explain what camera, text, focus, grain, or graphic motion contributes without mislabeling it as physical action
why_this_choice: explain why this architecture best serves the shot's responsibility and style
alternatives_considered: record a simpler or different construction considered and why it was not chosen
risk_flags: record shot-specific contact, support, scale, identity, direction, occlusion, or pacing risks
proof_plan: describe the rendered evidence that will determine whether the shot worked

observed_visible_changes: record what actually changed, or leave this empty when intentional stillness fulfils the shot
rendered_review.review_notes: Explain why the rendered shot fulfils its declared responsibility.
